name: LOLIN S2 Mini
description: D1-mini-sized ESP32-S2FN4R2 board (4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM) with USB-C, native USB and 27 GPIOs for about $5; cheap CircuitPython/USB-HID board, no Bluetooth.
notes: ESP32-S2 is single-core Xtensa with Wi-Fi 4 only (no Bluetooth). Native USB-OTG only, no UART bridge: hold button 0 and tap RST for the bootloader.
Compatible with LOLIN D1 mini shields (2x8 outer headers) but has 32 pins in total; DAC on GPIO17/18; blue LED on GPIO15.
No mechanical drawing for the extra pins, so no header data.
